name: kanban
description: Kanban's tracked Codex workflows: the Kanban-invoked $solve, $pr-review, $pr-rereview, $pr-revise, and $repair, plus the user-invoked $issue, $autoissue, $issue-review, $issue-rereview, $design-epic, $process-design-doc, $draft-report, $note-problem, $process-report, and $triage drafting, readiness-gate, document, and roadmap workflows.

interface.longDescription: Packages the Codex-side workflows the Kanban board invokes by name: $solve claims and implements a GitHub issue through PR creation, $pr-review and $pr-rereview run the canonical opposite-brand pull request review, $pr-revise repairs a changes-requested pull request and hands off to a fresh canonical rereview, and $repair unblocks a pull request that cannot merge and hands off to exactly one rereview. It also packages the drafting, readiness-gate, and document workflows a user or the review daemon invokes directly rather than Kanban's CLI: $issue drafts exactly one verified, deduplicated issue and stops for signoff, $autoissue delegates that drafting and then immediately runs the canonical review of the created issue, $issue-review runs the canonical opposite-agent readiness gate for one numbered issue, $issue-rereview repairs a changes-requested issue with explicit signoff and resubmits it to that gate, $design-epic captures an epic-sized feature arc in a durable Markdown design document before any tracker item exists, $process-design-doc turns one entry of such a document into one approved tracker artifact, $draft-report turns notes or an audit request into an evidence-backed findings report, $note-problem appends one verified observation to an existing report after explicit approval, $process-report processes one concern of such a report at a time, and $triage orders a repository's open issues into a dependency-aware roadmap. Each workflow preserves Kanban's existing solver, reviewer, and revision authority boundaries described in docs/agent-workflow-contract.md, docs/drafting-workflow-contract.md, and docs/document-workflow-contract.md.
defaultPrompt: Use $solve to claim GitHub issue #123, implement it in an isolated worktree, and open a tested PR.
Use $pr-review to review pull request #38 through the canonical opposite-brand workflow.
Use $pr-rereview to rereview pull request #38 after its author pushes changes.
Use $pr-revise to address the canonical changes-requested review on PR #38.
Use $repair to unblock pull request #38 and hand it off to one canonical rereview.
Use $issue to find and draft one actionable issue, stopping for my signoff before creating it.
Use $autoissue to draft one issue, create it after my signoff, and immediately run its canonical review.
Use $issue-review to run the canonical opposite-agent readiness gate for issue #123.
Use $issue-rereview to repair issue #123 after its readiness gate requested changes, then resubmit it.
Use $design-epic to capture the feature arc I am describing in a durable design document.
Use $process-design-doc to file the next ready slice of that design document as a tracker item.
Use $draft-report to turn my audit notes into an evidence-backed findings report.
Use $note-problem to note and verify one problem into that findings report.
Use $process-report to process the next open concern in that findings report.
Use $triage to order this repository's open issues into a dependency-aware roadmap.
